original.statement: From 1.12.6 to 1.13.0, the storage version of the clustercleanuppolicies.kyverno.io CRD moves from v2beta1 to v2, so existing ClusterCleanupPolicy objects need a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update before v2beta1 is removed in a later release.

decision.reason: [ev-b01406e79da0] shows the storage flag of clustercleanuppolicies.kyverno.io spec.versions[name=v2] going from false to true between 1.12.6 and 1.13.0, and [ev-56c06982a6c5] shows v2beta1 going from true to false. The upstream change text says existing objects stay stored as v2beta1 until rewritten, and that a storage version migration plus a status.storedVersions update must run before a later release removes v2beta1. That is an operator step, so the migration family with migration-required fits. The kebab-case name is built from the evidence's own words. P1's crd-field subject was refuted by the validator, and P3's compatibility-boundary subject does not fit this change.
